feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: iterations 0 to 4 (60 development trials each) all ended off track with exactly one line-loss event and max_error of about 0.062 m, just above the 0.06 m limit. Oscillation stayed low (0.08 to 0.15), so the robot is drifting to an edge rather than weaving. Iteration 4 (search_right, base_speed 1.0, kp 2.5) scored 57.612, essentially level with iteration 3 (57.6456, last_direction), so the recovery mode did not move the failure point. Iteration 4 also showed that oval progress (0.21) and s-bend/slalom progress (0.13, 0.08) respond to base_speed in opposite directions. This candidate keeps the iteration 4 geometry, base_speed, ki, kd, sensor weights and search_right, and changes only kp from 2.5 to 2.0. That is the single-variable test of bend-entry turn authority that the previous feedback set up. It is valid and not obviously broken: kp 2.0 was used in the iteration 0 baseline, and the change is small. Revising first would cost two of the four remaining review and revision runs for a change that only a race can judge, so approve it and read the race as follows. (1) If max_error falls below 0.06 m and progress rises on any track, kp was the limit; then try kp 1.5 to 1.8 with base_speed 1.0 before changing anything else. (2) If progress and max_error are unchanged, turn authority is not the limit, and the next test is sensor geometry (sensor_size 0.016, or a span of about 0.05 m with the 16 mm sensors) rather than more gain changes. (3) If progress falls on the s-bend or slalom, kp 2.5 was needed for the bends, and the next lever is base_speed between 1.0 and 1.2 with kp 2.5.
requested_changes: Race as written. If max_error drops below 0.06 m and progress rises on any track, keep kp near 2.0 and try 1.5 to 1.8 next, holding base_speed 1.0 and search_right.
If progress and max_error are unchanged across tracks, stop tuning kp and test sensor geometry next: sensor_size 0.016 with the same x positions, or a span of about 0.05 m, keeping kp 2.0.
If progress falls on the s-bend or slalom, restore kp 2.5 and test base_speed 1.1 to 1.2 with search_right, since iteration 3 and 4 showed the bend tracks need more speed while the oval needs less.
